description: This file defines the XmlRpcReader class, which provides functionality to parse XML-RPC messages into internal data structures, including method calls, data, structs, and arrays. It uses a dispatch dictionary to map XML element types to corresponding parsing functions.

classes.name: XmlRpcReader
classes.description: A class that reads XML and converts it into RPC entities, supporting method call parsing and data mapping.

methods.name: MapToMethodCall
methods.description: Maps an XML element to an RPC method call, extracting method name and parameters.

methods.name: MapToData
methods.description: Maps an XML element to RPC data, dispatching based on the value type.

methods.name: MapToStruct
methods.description: Maps an XML element to an RPC struct, converting members into key-value pairs.

methods.name: MapToArray
methods.description: Maps an XML element to an RPC array, converting data elements into a list.

methods.name: MapValue
methods.description: Maps an XML container to RPC data, dispatching based on the contained element's type.
